names.legendary: Captain Schipp, Admiral of the Canals

lore.common: Barks at every passing barge until it remembers the barge is the one it lives on.
lore.uncommon: Inspects the boatman's sandwiches at each lock and applies a one-biscuit inspection fee.
lore.rare: Knows every canal turn and wakes the captain with a bark if the wrong bridge approaches.
lore.epic: Chased a rat through an entire cargo ship, rearranging the crew's luggage into a makeshift obstacle course.
lore.legendary: Captain Schipp navigated a hundred misty canals without a chart, guided only by the sound of distant bells. The bargemen now leave an extra sandwich at every lock.

names.legendary: Laird McWhiskers, the Unbudging

lore.common: Refuses to walk in any direction that was suggested by a human.
lore.uncommon: Struts through the park with a beard so grand that the pigeons mistake it for a visiting dignitary.
lore.rare: Digs through the garden after one elusive mole, then offers the hole as a gift to its furious owner.
lore.epic: Barked at a Highland bagpipe concert until the musicians changed key to suit its mood. The conductor now carries dog biscuits.
lore.legendary: Laird McWhiskers inherited a castle, inspected every room and refused to move into it until the carpets were spotless. The ghosts spent a century learning to vacuum.

names.legendary: Morag, the Shadow Along the Highlands

lore.common: Stretches across the whole sofa and leaves its owner exactly one cushion.
lore.uncommon: Moves over a hill with such long, quiet strides that the sheep never notice it coming.
lore.rare: Outruns a mountain gust, then stops dead to admire a single tiny flower.
lore.epic: Leapt across a ravine with such grace that the shepherds started measuring bridges in deerhound lengths.
lore.legendary: Morag once carried a message across the Highlands before its ink was dry. The sender arrived years later to find the answer waiting beside a still-warm hearth.

names.legendary: Sir Sealyham, Jester of the Burrows

lore.common: Has so much eyebrow that it must lift its whole head to see the biscuit in front of it.
lore.uncommon: Runs through one patch of mud and turns its brilliant white coat into modern art.
lore.rare: Digs down a badger tunnel, then returns wearing the badger's expression of complete disapproval.
lore.epic: Took over the village dog show by telling terrible jokes to the judges until every other dog was disqualified for laughing.
lore.legendary: Sir Sealyham once made a solemn castle ghost laugh so hard it became visible. He has served as the castle's official jester ever since, paid entirely in roast chicken.

names.legendary: Sheltara, Bell of the Isles

lore.common: Alerts the entire street when a leaf lands in its garden without permission.
lore.uncommon: Herds a family of ducks into a neat line, then insists on counting them again.
lore.rare: Can guide a scattered flock through fog by barking instructions only the sheep understand.
lore.epic: Rounded up every pony on the island into a perfect spiral. The farmers spent three days trying to find the beginning of the line.
lore.legendary: Sheltara led the last sheep of a storm-lost island home by singing through the gale. The cliffs still echo her bark whenever a flock wanders near the edge.

names.legendary: Shihzara, Empress of the Laundry Basket

lore.common: Refuses to walk until someone fixes the hair bow covering both eyes.
lore.uncommon: Sits on a cushion like a tiny emperor and judges every guest's socks.
lore.rare: Sweeps a grand ballroom clean with its flowing coat and demands a biscuit as wages.
lore.epic: Took over the palace beauty salon and issued compulsory ribbons to every guard. Even the statues wore matching bows.
lore.legendary: Shihzara was offered a golden throne by three emperors but chose the laundry basket instead. Each empire now sends tribute in the form of freshly warmed towels.

names.legendary: Siberia Sasha, the Undeportable Explorer

lore.common: Argues with the bathtub in a voice that sounds suspiciously like NOOOOO.
lore.uncommon: Digs a personal air-conditioned pit beneath the flowerbed and refuses to pay rent.
lore.rare: Escapes the most secure kennel simply by convincing the other dogs to open the gate.
lore.epic: Led the championship sled team straight to a sausage stall instead of the finish line. The judges awarded points for enthusiasm.
lore.legendary: Sasha crossed the endless polar night to deliver medicine to a forgotten outpost, then escaped every celebration arranged in her honour. Her pawprints still appear wherever a gate is left unlocked.

names.legendary: Silktoria, the Tiny Lion of the Outback

lore.common: Stares down a kookaburra until it laughs, then barks at the joke.
lore.uncommon: Keeps its silky blue-and-tan fur so polished that the garden gnomes use it as a mirror.
lore.rare: Chases a snake out of the flowerbed with nothing but an outrageously confident bark.
lore.epic: Guarded the entire farmyard from a flock of cockatoos. The birds fled to the owner's car and redecorated it with stolen seed.
lore.legendary: Silktoria defeated the great desert serpent with a growl too small for anyone else to hear. The serpent still blushes when it sees a terrier in a fancy bow.

names.legendary: Sir Wheatalot of the Unfinished Hello

lore.common: Greets the bin collector with such enthusiasm that the bin goes over and the dog goes into it.
lore.uncommon: Stores crumbs in its silky beard and pretends this is sophisticated grooming.
lore.rare: Leaps high enough to kiss a giant on the nose, then insists the giant kiss it back.
lore.epic: Welcomed an entire parade so vigorously that every marcher got airborne. The mayor awarded it a medal from a safe distance.
lore.legendary: Sir Wheatalot stood at the gates of a city that had forgotten how to smile. By sundown every face was grinning and every coat was covered in golden fur.

names.legendary: Sir Stafford, Knight of the Open Door

lore.common: Wags its entire body until its back legs forget which way to go.
lore.uncommon: Greets the postman with so many kisses that his hat needs a towel.
lore.rare: Carries a fallen tree branch home as a gift, ignoring the fact that the branch is longer than the house.
lore.epic: Dragged a stalled carnival float uphill because it thought the children were waiting to ride. The float was still decorated with balloons.
lore.legendary: Sir Stafford guarded a village of frightened pups through a winter storm, then knocked down the castle gates with the sheer force of his greeting when help finally arrived.

names.legendary: Duchess Poodoria, the Unruffled

lore.common: Emerges from the groomer looking like royalty, then dives into the first muddy puddle.
lore.uncommon: Retrieves a duck from the pond and asks the duck to admire its new haircut.
lore.rare: Solves the complicated locks on the treat cupboard, then leaves the other dogs a step-by-step diagram.
lore.epic: Shook its freshly groomed curls at the county fair, releasing a pink storm of ribbons, hairspray and bewildered judges.
lore.legendary: Duchess Poodoria crossed the lake during the royal dog show and returned with the missing crown. Not a curl was wet, and the crown was polished.

names.legendary: Herr Schnauzen, Keeper of the Gate

lore.common: Inspects every visitor's shoes and growls at anyone who arrived without biscuits.
lore.uncommon: Uses its enormous eyebrows to look disappointed at humans who make poor decisions.
lore.rare: Finds any missing farm animal by following one invisible whisker-twitching trail.
lore.epic: Ran the entire farm like a frontier town, putting escaped hens on trial and a very guilty rooster in charge of the jury.
lore.legendary: Herr Schnauzen kept watch over the oldest mountain farm for a hundred imaginary winters. No fox ever stole a hen, and no villager ever misplaced a key.

names.legendary: Lord Sussex, the Faithful Tracker

lore.common: Looks disappointed in every biscuit, including the one it begged for.
lore.uncommon: Narrates its own tracking adventures in a deep, worried little bark.
lore.rare: Pushes through thorns and briars without losing the trail or its profoundly offended expression.
lore.epic: Sniffed out every lost picnic in the county and returned the baskets in order of how good the sandwiches smelled.
lore.legendary: Lord Sussex followed a vanished hunter's trail across fifty autumns, finding his old horn buried in a meadow. Each year the dogs still gather to hear it sound.

names.legendary: Dorjemane, Warden of the Silent Pass

lore.common: Barks at midnight because a snowflake landed on the wrong fencepost.
lore.uncommon: Carries a magnificent mane and refuses to acknowledge the existence of raincoats.
lore.rare: Can smell an approaching snow leopard from across the valley and sends the goats home before sunset.
lore.epic: Roared into an avalanche and split it around the mountain village, leaving every roof untouched and every yak thoroughly impressed.
lore.legendary: Dorjemane guarded the high pass through a century of bitter winters. It never asked travellers for tribute, only that the last in line be helped across.

names.legendary: Lhapa, Bearer of the Lucky Path

lore.common: Walks over fresh snow on broad paws while everyone else's boots sink.
lore.uncommon: Is so shaggy that strangers mistake it for a particularly friendly floor rug.
lore.rare: Finds a safe foothold on cliffs where even the mountain goats have stopped climbing.
lore.epic: Shook a winter's worth of snow from its fur into the mountain square, giving every child a sledding hill before lunch.
lore.legendary: Lhapa carried a blessing down from a remote monastery in its thick coat. Every village it visited found one lost thing returned by morning.

names.legendary: Mimi Pompadour of the Diamond Collar

lore.common: Looks scandalised when a muddy leaf touches its freshly groomed fur.
lore.uncommon: Walks on tiptoe past puddles and still manages to demand a bath.
lore.rare: Opens the treat cupboard with one delicate paw and leaves no evidence except the crumbs on its beard.
lore.epic: Won every dog show in the county by performing a ballet on the judge's hat. The other dogs formed a union.
lore.legendary: Mimi Pompadour was once carried to the royal ball inside a silk handbag and emerged to dance with the prince. She refused the crown but accepted a lifetime supply of biscuits.

names.legendary: Tobias Tinyfang of the Midnight Watch

lore.common: Shivers under three blankets while barking at the radiator.
lore.uncommon: Hears a mouse sneeze in the attic and files a full report with the family.
lore.rare: Picks up a distant radio station through its enormous ears and barks the weather forecast.
lore.epic: Alerted an entire castle to a thief with one magnificent bark; the thief ran straight into the guardroom and requested earplugs.
lore.legendary: Tobias Tinyfang defended the first toy shop from a winter's worth of wandering mice. He was awarded a castle no larger than a shoebox and guarded it with the pride of a lion.

names.legendary: Vizsaria, the Unbroken Trail

lore.common: Follows you into the bathroom and looks heartbroken when the door closes.
lore.uncommon: Has such a magnificent copper coat that autumn leaves feel underdressed.
lore.rare: Points at a pheasant with such conviction that the entire hunting party freezes behind it.
lore.epic: Crossed a vast estate in a flash of red, returning with every lost picnic basket and exactly one rather offended goose.
lore.legendary: Tracked a vanished explorer across a hundred miles of rain-washed wilderness. When the trail ended, it pointed at the sunrise; the explorer walked home beneath it.

names.legendary: Walkerius, the Echo Without End

lore.common: Barks at streetlights with exactly the same urgency as at raccoons.
lore.uncommon: Follows a scent so enthusiastically that its owner's boots have to run after it.
lore.rare: Bays across three valleys to inform everyone that it has found a squirrel.
lore.epic: Pursued a fox's scent through an entire county fair, dragging a parade, two mayors and an extremely confused marching band behind it.
lore.legendary: Followed the last lost note of an ancient hunting horn through mountain mist. When it howled the note back, the old trails shone beneath the grass.

names.legendary: Weimara, the Silver Ghost of the Hunt

lore.common: Stares at the dinner table until the sausages feel guilty.
lore.uncommon: Follows its owner so closely that the two cast one long shadow.
lore.rare: Opens every cupboard in the house but refuses to shut a single door.
lore.epic: Raided the wedding cake before the first dance, emerging in a cloud of icing like a silver phantom. Every photograph caught the guilty grin.
lore.legendary: Followed a moonlit trail to find a lost search party in the hills. Its pale coat shone through the mist like a moving lantern all the way home.

names.legendary: Dewiglen, the Red Valley Guardian

lore.common: Leaps into hedges that looked completely empty a second earlier.
lore.uncommon: Comes out of the undergrowth with half the forest stuck to its ears.
lore.rare: Finds lost birds in the thicket and politely informs them they're supposed to fly.
lore.epic: Sprang through a famous hedge maze in three bounds and carved a shortcut for generations of confused tourists.
lore.legendary: Kept watch over the mountain valley in its bright red-and-white coat. When the winter fog swallowed the paths, travellers followed its joyful bark back to the hearths.

names.legendary: Hamish MacDig, the White Highland Wind

lore.common: Leaves a perfect muddy pawprint on every clean cushion.
lore.uncommon: Turns from white to earthy brown within nine seconds of a bath.
lore.rare: Burrows under a hedge and reappears with somebody else's garden glove.
lore.epic: Charged across the Highland Games as a rolling white blur, dragging a pipe band, two judges and the prize haggis behind it.
lore.legendary: Dug a passage through the hills to rescue travellers trapped by an avalanche. Emerged white as snow, shook once, and buried the entire rescue party in mud.

names.legendary: Whipster, the Lightning That Naps

lore.common: Sprints for thirty seconds, then sleeps for the rest of the afternoon.
lore.uncommon: Demands a blanket even on the warmest day of summer.
lore.rare: Catches a flying ball before it lands, without disturbing its elegant ears.
lore.epic: Raced down the coastline in a blur of legs and sand, overtook a train, then curled up in its own jumper for a nap on the platform.
lore.legendary: Crossed an entire frozen moor to bring help to a stranded traveller, running faster than the storm behind it. Fell asleep on the rescue crew's boots the moment everyone was safe.

names.legendary: Luminara, the White Spirit of the Pack

lore.common: Howls at the freezer because it sounds almost like the Arctic wind.
lore.uncommon: Disappears into fresh snow, leaving only two very curious ears.
lore.rare: Guides its pack across thin ice by listening for the secret cracks beneath the surface.
lore.epic: Called its pack through an Arctic blizzard with a howl so deep that the northern lights swayed to the sound.
lore.legendary: Guarded the first winter trail beneath the aurora, leading lost travellers to shelter without ever showing its face. Only a row of pale pawprints and a distant song proved it was there.

names.legendary: Sir Foxford of the Borrowed Burrow

lore.common: Emerges from the hedge carrying somebody else's gardening glove.
lore.uncommon: Has a moustache so spiky that dusting becomes a full-contact sport.
lore.rare: Detects a fox tunnel through two metres of earth, then pops out wearing a crown of roots.
lore.epic: Colonel Scruffcharge led the village dogs in a dawn raid on the runaway garden gnomes. Their only casualty was a very dignified flowerbed.
lore.legendary: Sir Foxford chased the final fox from an enchanted hill and inherited the burrow. He now runs a polite underground hotel for hedgehogs and charges guests one biscuit.

names.legendary: Lady Yorkina, Empress of the Mill

lore.common: Wears a pink bow and challenges the neighbour's wheelie bin to a duel.
lore.uncommon: Has a bark three sizes bigger than its actual body.
lore.rare: Can find the smallest mouse in a wool mill by following a single displaced thread.
lore.epic: Duchess Yapocalypse stopped an entire sheep parade by barking orders from a handbag. The sheep obeyed; the shepherds requested her business card.
lore.legendary: Lady Yorkina guarded the old textile mill long after its machines fell quiet. When the roof finally collapsed, she led every nesting mouse out through a secret tunnel and claimed the empty mill as her palace.

names.legendary: Matriarch Mnemosnoot

lore.common: Uses its trunk to steal hats and return them full of water.
lore.uncommon: Remembers who promised it a peanut in 2014. The debt is accruing interest.
lore.rare: Can hear a distant rainstorm through its feet, but cannot hear the keeper saying bath time is over.
lore.epic: Sneezed while taking a mud bath and redecorated the entire safari lodge. The tourists called it an immersive experience.
lore.legendary: Her rumble crossed a continent and summoned every elephant to one ancient watering hole. They came for the family reunion; somebody had told them there was cake.

names.legendary: Reynalda, the Cleverest Tail

lore.common: Steals one shoe from every doorstep on the street, never the matching one.
lore.uncommon: Dives head-first into deep snow to catch a mouse and comes up with a snowy moustache.
lore.rare: Screams in the garden at midnight so dramatically that the whole street thinks a film is being made.
lore.epic: Outsmarted every hen house in the county in a single week. The hens now sleep with the doors locked from inside.
lore.legendary: Talked its way into running the farm, the henhouse and the village bakery, all on the same afternoon.

names.legendary: Lupa, Who Taught the Moon to Howl

lore.common: Practises a terrifying growl that comes out as a hiccup.
lore.uncommon: Borrows the pack leader's enormous footprint and pretends it is its own.
lore.rare: Hears a lost packmate's heartbeat through snow and guides the whole family to safety.
lore.epic: Little Fenrir tried his first proper howl and accidentally summoned every village dog to the forest. They founded a choir; the cats formed an opposition party.
lore.legendary: On the night the moon lost its voice, Lupa climbed the tallest ridge and sang until the silver light answered. Wolves have sung back to her ever since, even when the sky is cloudy.

names.legendary: Lady Longneck, Who Sees Tomorrow

lore.common: Eats the leaves off the top of every tree in the park, so they all look like they've had bad haircuts.
lore.uncommon: Licks its own ears with its long purple tongue and offers to do yours.
lore.rare: Spots what everyone is having for dinner two streets away and turns up at the right window, every night.
lore.epic: Walked through the city and accidentally untangled every telephone wire with its neck.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall that it got a job as the city's weather forecaster. It just looks over the clouds and reports back.

names.legendary: Billy Bramblebeard, Eater of All

lore.common: Eats the washing off the line, the pegs and half the line.
lore.uncommon: Climbs onto the roof of the shed, the car and the farmer's tractor to get a better view.
lore.rare: Headbutts anything that looks at it twice, including its reflection in the window.
lore.epic: Ate a path straight through the hedge maze and opened a shortcut for the tourists.
lore.legendary: Climbed the tallest mountain in the land and then ate the flag at the top.

names.legendary: Lady Wheekington, Duchess of Lettuce

lore.common: Hears the fridge door from three rooms away and summons dinner with a squeak.
lore.uncommon: Pops into the air for joy, lands sideways and pretends it planned the manoeuvre.
lore.rare: Rumbles so deeply during a cuddle that the table begins vibrating like a tiny motorboat.
lore.epic: Ate through a mountain of hay in one evening. The farmers now refer to the missing barn as a weather event.
lore.legendary: Lady Wheekington convenes the Great Lettuce Council each spring. Every vegetable farmer must present tribute or endure the loudest wheek in recorded history.

names.legendary: Sir Shredwick, King of the Paper Nest

lore.common: Runs a marathon on a squeaky wheel at three in the morning and sleeps through the applause.
lore.uncommon: Packs enough food into its cheeks to pass for a pair of fluffy earmuffs.
lore.rare: Escapes its cage, explores the house and returns before breakfast with a souvenir sock.
lore.epic: Spun its wheel so fiercely that it powered the village fair after the generator failed. The prizes were all tiny cardboard tubes.
lore.legendary: Sir Shredwick built an empire beneath the classroom from shredded homework. The teacher now accepts excuses written on hamster-sized parchment.

names.legendary: Hippomax, Keeper of the River Throne

lore.common: Yawns so widely that the crocodiles have started using its mouth to check the weather.
lore.uncommon: Wears mud like a luxury spa treatment and considers clean water deeply suspicious.
lore.rare: Flicks its tail so powerfully that the riverbank gets a surprise shower. Every bird has learned to duck.
lore.epic: Belly-flopped into the river and launched every boat onto the shore. The boat owners now book the splash as a yearly attraction.
lore.legendary: Hippomax sat at the centre of the first great river and refused to move until the water flowed gently around him. Fishermen still navigate by his enormous muddy silhouette.

names.legendary: Silvermane, Steed of the Unbroken Wind

lore.common: Eats your apple, then inspects your pockets for evidence of more apples.
lore.uncommon: Kicks its stable door at dawn like a landlord demanding breakfast.
lore.rare: Gallops so swiftly that the field gate swings open a full minute after it passes.
lore.epic: Led a stampede of wild horses across the royal parade. The king arrived at his coronation with hay in his crown.
lore.legendary: Silvermane outran the north wind to deliver a lost foal home before the first winter snowfall. The wind still trains at night, hoping for a rematch.

names.legendary: Solmane, the Throne That Never Moves

lore.common: Sleeps all afternoon, then announces it has been extremely busy guarding the rock.
lore.uncommon: Shakes its mane after a bath and resembles a very grumpy haystack.
lore.rare: Roars across the savannah so loudly that distant zebras forget why they were running.
lore.epic: Occupied the only waterhole during the dry season and demanded that every animal queue in order of height. The giraffes objected to being last.
lore.legendary: Solmane has ruled from the same sun-warmed stone since the days when the grasslands first turned gold. No crown rests on its head; the whole horizon bends quietly toward its roar.

names.legendary: Capuchino, Professor of the Stolen Tool

lore.common: Taps every nut with a stone and judges the results like a tiny restaurant critic.
lore.uncommon: Rubs ants into its fur as bug repellent. The other monkeys sit upwind.
lore.rare: Unzips bags, opens padlocks and steals keys. Its criminal record is ninety percent snacks.
lore.epic: Built an entire workshop in the canopy and taught monkeys to dismantle tourist cameras. The repair fees fund the banana budget.
lore.legendary: Capuchino forged the first tool that ever made a human jealous. His invention was a perfect nutcracker; his second was a machine that makes humans fetch nuts.

names.legendary: Colobara, Queen of the White Mantle

lore.common: Eats with its whole hand and then lectures everyone about table manners.
lore.uncommon: Borrows a baby from another monkey to babysit, then forgets whose it is. The troop has started using name tags.
lore.rare: Leaps between trees without touching the branches, leaving a fluttering white bridge of fur for the baby monkeys following behind.
lore.epic: Swept across the rainforest canopy in one mighty jump and turned a quiet afternoon into an aerial fashion parade. The parrots were furious about being upstaged.
lore.legendary: Colobara's silver mantle is woven from moonlit leaves. When she leaps between ancient trees, the forest itself seems to glide after her, though she still drops half her lunch.

names.legendary: Gorillion, the Gentle Mountain

lore.common: Burps after every meal to tell the troop it's happy. The troop burps back.
lore.uncommon: Peels bananas with remarkable delicacy and then eats the peel by accident.
lore.rare: Settles arguments with one raised eyebrow and a surprisingly polite grunt.
lore.epic: Beat the thunder in a drumming contest and silenced the whole jungle. Then apologised to the clouds.
lore.legendary: Gorillion once held two quarrelling mountains apart with his enormous hands. When peace returned, he planted bananas in the valley and retired as its gardener.

names.legendary: Gwenara, the Thousand-Faced Queen

lore.common: Stuffs both cheeks with mango, then asks for another as though it has never eaten.
lore.uncommon: Wears such a bright face that parrots accuse it of stealing their colours.
lore.rare: Mimics the rival troop's leader perfectly, then makes a face no leader would ever admit to making.
lore.epic: Stole the village market's fruit and replaced every stall sign with a tiny portrait of itself. Business improved.
lore.legendary: Gwenara knows the secret face of every creature in the forest. Once she laughed at the storm so convincingly that the clouds burst into sunshine.

names.legendary: Bellowmore, Voice of the First Morning

lore.common: Announces sunrise three hours early, just to make absolutely sure nobody misses it.
lore.uncommon: Sleeps all afternoon to recharge a scream that can wake the next valley.
lore.rare: Lets out a howl so deep that every leaf in its tree hums for an hour.
lore.epic: Led a chorus so loud that a distant airport mistook it for a landing announcement. The planes circled the jungle waiting for instructions.
lore.legendary: Bellowmore sang the first dawn into the forest and has never missed an encore. Legends say the sun refuses to rise until it clears its throat.

names.legendary: Indira, the Voice Between the Trees

lore.common: Sings at breakfast as though the entire jungle bought tickets.
lore.uncommon: Leaps sideways between trunks like a ballerina who refuses to face forward.
lore.rare: Its eerie call carries so far that ships off the coast swear a whale is singing in the forest.
lore.epic: Gathered every lemur family to perform a dawn opera in the treetops. Even the waterfalls quietened for the final note.
lore.legendary: Indira sang to the oldest baobab when it was dying. The tree put out new leaves to hear the next verse, and the forest has never forgotten the song.

names.legendary: Languraja, Warden of the High Temple

lore.common: Drops leaves onto tourists who are trying very hard to take serious photographs.
lore.uncommon: Uses its long tail as a balancing pole and considers washing lines public roads.
lore.rare: Can steal a banana from a market stall without disturbing a single grape beside it.
lore.epic: Marched a troop across the rooftops at noon, draping every clothesline with stolen scarves. The old quarter looked ready for a royal parade.
lore.legendary: Languraja was appointed guardian of the hilltop temple by a king who forgot to ask the monkeys. Its descendants still patrol the rooftops and demand tribute in mangoes.

names.legendary: Queen Cattara, the Sun's First Disciple

lore.common: Sits cross-legged toward the sunrise like a tiny monk waiting for breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Waves its striped tail above the grass so every cousin can find the picnic.
lore.rare: Perfumes its tail with something unspeakable, then challenges the rival troop to a duel.
lore.epic: Unfurled a thousand striped tails across the treetops. The island mistook them for battle flags and the neighbouring monkeys surrendered their fruit.
lore.legendary: Queen Cattara once convinced the sleeping sun to rise by warming her palms toward the horizon. Each dawn her ringed tail counts the minutes before the light arrives.

names.legendary: Marmolina, Guardian of the Twin Moons

lore.common: Makes a noise so high that the dog looks at the ceiling in confusion.
lore.uncommon: Carries two babies at once and asks the rest of the troop why they are standing around.
lore.rare: Opens a hidden well of gum in the bark, then guards it like a miniature treasure chest.
lore.epic: Set up a treetop nursery with dozens of branches connected by swinging vines. The babies now run the place.
lore.legendary: Marmolina once raised two orphaned stars in the hollow of a forest tree. When they were old enough to shine, she released them together, and the night sky gained its twin moons.

names.legendary: King Chatterfang, Thief of Golden Fruit

lore.common: Opens its banana from the end you didn't expect, then points and laughs at yours.
lore.uncommon: Treats the washing line as a jungle vine and the curtains as an emergency landing pad.
lore.rare: Steals every tourist hat in the market and crowns itself with a tower of sun visors.
lore.epic: Raided an entire banana plantation before breakfast, then built a banana fortress from the peels. The farmer has requested negotiations.
lore.legendary: Chatterfang stole the golden fruit of the old forest and hid it atop a palace no climber could reach. Its descendants still guard the tree, mostly because nobody remembers how to get down.

names.legendary: Borneo Bram, Builder of the Skybridge

lore.common: Makes a fresh leafy bed every evening and complains if the pillows are uneven.
lore.uncommon: Carries a huge leaf as an umbrella, then offers it to the nearest soaked squirrel.
lore.rare: Weaves an impossible bridge through the canopy without breaking a living branch.
lore.epic: Built a treetop library with swinging entrances and a strict no-banana-stains rule. Even the tigers started borrowing books.
lore.legendary: Borneo Bram joined the crowns of two ancient forests with living vines, giving stranded animals a road above the flood. He still charges one ripe fig for passage.

names.legendary: Patarion, Runner of the Burning Plain

lore.common: Stands tall in the savannah grass and immediately forgets what it was looking for.
lore.uncommon: Sprints to the far tree, then returns to check whether anyone was impressed.
lore.rare: Outruns a pursuing cheetah and stops to offer it a motivational speech.
lore.epic: Ran circles around an entire safari convoy until the vehicles ran out of fuel. The tourists returned by following its footprints.
lore.legendary: Patarion carried warning of a great wildfire across the grasslands before the smoke reached the horizon. Every troop escaped, and the wind still races to keep up with his descendants.

names.legendary: Nasalor, Herald of the River Canopy

lore.common: Its nose arrives at the fruit bowl several seconds before the rest of it.
lore.uncommon: Honks through its enormous nose until the whole mangrove answers in confusion.
lore.rare: Senses rising river water through its nose and leads the troop to safety before the first flood.
lore.epic: Sneezed from the tallest branch and sent a tidal splash through the mangroves. Even the crocodiles asked for tissues.
lore.legendary: Nasalor's great nose once called the lost river home through a thousand reeds. The mangroves still bend aside whenever his descendants pass.

names.legendary: Siamara, Voice of the First Forest

lore.common: Inflates its throat pouch and wakes the entire neighbourhood before breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Duets with its mate across the treetops, interrupting every jungle bird's attempt at a solo.
lore.rare: Sends a call rolling between valleys so the whole canopy knows where its family has gone.
lore.epic: Sang a duet so thunderous that the jungle's sleeping flowers opened at midnight. The insects demanded an encore.
lore.legendary: Siamara sang the first dawn into the canopy when the forest was young. Each morning the echoes return one note of that song, and her family sings the rest.

names.legendary: Saimora, Five-Handed Thief of the Sun

lore.common: Borrows everyone's bananas while hanging upside down with an innocent expression.
lore.uncommon: Uses its tail to steal a second snack while both hands are pretending to behave.
lore.rare: Swings through the canopy on a path invisible to other monkeys, reaching the fruit trees before dawn.
lore.epic: Gathered forty spider monkeys into one enormous swinging chain that carried a lost expedition across a ravine. Payment was demanded in mangoes.
lore.legendary: Saimora once stole a golden ray of sunset with its prehensile tail and hid it in the rainforest. That is why the canopy glows after dark.

names.legendary: Saimirina, the Golden-Eyed Jester

lore.common: Bounces from branch to branch so fast that its own tail arrives late.
lore.uncommon: Steals a banana, hides behind another monkey and loudly accuses the parrot.
lore.rare: Can summon an entire troop with one squeak, arriving in a chattering blur before the fruit hits the ground.
lore.epic: Turned a quiet jungle clearing into a bouncing riot of fifty monkeys and a thousand stolen mangoes. The jaguar requested earplugs.
lore.legendary: Saimirina once stole a sunrise from the tallest jungle tree and hid it behind her golden eyes. Every dawn the forest asks her to give it back.

names.legendary: Tardigrand, the Forest's Longest Day

lore.common: Takes so long to wave hello that the other animals have already gone home.
lore.uncommon: Grows a respectable little garden of algae in its fur and refuses to mow it.
lore.rare: Slows the ticking of nearby clocks so it can finish a nap before breakfast.
lore.epic: Took one deliberate step across a collapsing branch and held it steady until an entire troop of monkeys had crossed.
lore.legendary: Tardigrand has watched a single seed grow into an ancient forest without ever leaving his branch. To him, patience is not waiting; it is the way mountains speak.

names.legendary: Titiana, Singer of the Two-Tailed Song

lore.common: Loops its tail around its best friend's and refuses to let go at snack time.
lore.uncommon: Sings its morning duet so loudly that the neighbouring monkeys demand an encore.
lore.rare: Braids a whole troop's tails together to cross a gap in the forest, then charges a banana per crossing.
lore.epic: Organised a canopy-wide dance by linking tails across a hundred branches; even the jaguars joined before noticing they were dancing.
lore.legendary: Titiana's duet with her mate is said to hold the rainforest's oldest memory. When one voice falls silent, the other carries its melody until a new dawn answers.

names.legendary: Grandmaster Bao of the Bamboo Court

lore.common: Eats bamboo for fourteen hours a day, then complains that there's nothing in the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Rolls down hills on purpose and looks surprised at the bottom every time.
lore.rare: Negotiates with every bamboo shoot before eating it. They always lose, but appreciate the formality.
lore.epic: Rolled downhill through a royal garden and flattened every carefully planted hedge into the shape of a sleeping panda. The gardener declared it modern landscape art.
lore.legendary: Grandmaster Bao guarded the last living bamboo grove during a century of drought. He shared every new shoot with the forest creatures, then ate the ceremonial ribbon at the reopening.

names.legendary: Sir Snortimus, Finder of Buried Gold

lore.common: Rolls in the mud immediately after bath time and returns indoors to show everybody.
lore.uncommon: Unearths the truffles the farmer spent all morning looking for, then demands payment in biscuits.
lore.rare: Squeals so fiercely at dinner that the farmhouse windows rattle and the clocks run early.
lore.epic: Turned the village green into a luxurious mud spa for every animal in the county. The mayor requested a refund on the lawn.
lore.legendary: Sir Snortimus followed a scent deep beneath the ancient forest and discovered a buried golden banquet hall. He kept the truffles and generously left the treasure to the humans.

names.legendary: Warrenella, Queen of a Thousand Doors

lore.common: Thumps the floor until somebody pays attention to the empty carrot bowl.
lore.uncommon: Eats the roses in the garden and leaves one leaf as a thank-you note.
lore.rare: Tunnels beneath locked gates and emerges inside the vegetable cupboard.
lore.epic: Dug a warren beneath the royal castle so enormous that the throne room developed a rabbit-sized underground railway.
lore.legendary: Warrenella excavated a warren beneath the palace with so many exits that the royal architect resigned. She now rents tunnels to the hedgehogs.

names.legendary: Ewelalia, the Cloud-Shearing Queen

lore.common: Baaed at its own reflection in the farm trough and demanded to meet the other sheep.
lore.uncommon: Gives the shepherd a fresh fluffy coat by brushing past, then steals it back at shearing time.
lore.rare: Convinces the entire flock to form a perfect circle around anyone eating a sandwich.
lore.epic: Escaped the meadow with two hundred relatives and occupied the wool shop. By morning every jumper was wearing a sheep.
lore.legendary: Ewelalia's fleece catches stray clouds and shears them into blankets for sleeping shepherds. Once a year she knits a new dawn from the mist rising off the hills.

names.legendary: Hazelnora, the Forest Queen

lore.common: Buries a hazelnut under the lawn and forgets it before turning around.
lore.uncommon: Breaks into a squirrel-proof bird feeder and leaves a tiny thank-you note.
lore.rare: Can summon buried acorns from any hiding place, though half emerge wearing somebody else's labels.
lore.epic: Led a midnight operation to empty every bird feeder in the park. By morning the statue of the mayor was wearing a crown of stolen peanuts.
lore.legendary: Hazelnora forgot where she buried a million acorns and accidentally planted an entire forest. Every tree remembers her, even though she remembers none of them.

names.legendary: Rajhara, the Tigress Between Shadows

lore.common: Hides behind a houseplant with its entire striped tail sticking out. It is convinced nobody sees it.
lore.uncommon: Walks across dry leaves without a sound, then sneezes at a butterfly.
lore.rare: Steps into a tiger-striped reflection and emerges from any other patch of striped sunlight.
lore.epic: Stalked the entire royal hunting party through a bamboo forest without once being seen; their lunch baskets mysteriously returned empty.
lore.legendary: Rajhara prowls the borders of the moonlit mangrove, where every stripe on her coat is a path through darkness. Even the jungle holds its breath when she takes a step.

names.legendary: Myrmex, the Endless Hunger

lore.common: Its nose can detect ants inside a sealed lunchbox. Its tongue has already opened the lid.
lore.uncommon: Unrolls its tongue across the garden like a pink measuring tape. The worms are deeply offended.
lore.rare: Can empty a termite mound before its residents finish saying good morning. Ants have started building decoy restaurants.
lore.epic: Unfurled a tongue across an entire valley and vacuumed up every ant before the royal picnic. The queen offered it a knighthood. It asked for seconds.
lore.legendary: Myrmex has pursued the oldest ant colony through a thousand forests. Some say its tongue can reach beneath the earth and taste tomorrow's harvest.

names.legendary: Oryxaris, Spear of the Endless Plain

lore.common: Bounces straight up when startled. Occasionally gets startled by its own landing.
lore.uncommon: Its ears swivel toward danger before danger knows it has arrived. Has never been caught by a sneezing lion.
lore.rare: Leaps over streams without disturbing the water. Grass bends aside to make way for its hooves.
lore.epic: Bounded across the savannah in twelve impossible strides, leaving thunder rolling in each hoofprint. The lions declared a temporary ban on racing.
lore.legendary: Oryxaris carries the horizon between its horns. Each time it leaps, the sun rises over a new valley, and even the wind has to run to catch up.

names.legendary: Cingulord, the Nine-Banded Fortress

lore.common: Wears its own little suit of armour to bed. Still insists on having the softest pillow.
lore.uncommon: Can dig under a garden fence in one sneeze. Usually emerges on the wrong side of the neighbour's barbecue.
lore.rare: Rolls into a plated ball that no predator can open. The local badgers have started using it as a bowling ball.
lore.epic: Curled into a living cannonball and rolled through an entire mountain fortress. The guards surrendered after realising they had been beaten by a very determined potato.
lore.legendary: Cingulord's armour is forged from nine ancient shields, each earned protecting a desert village. Beneath the plates lives a creature that is still terrified of loud fireworks.

names.legendary: Brockhollow, King Below

lore.common: Grumbles at earthworms for hiding underground, then digs up the entire flowerbed to lodge a complaint.
lore.uncommon: Changes its bedding more often than the royal palace. Its neighbours are asked to wipe their paws.
lore.rare: A striped little tyrant who has defended the same footpath against three tractors and one extremely nervous horse.
lore.epic: Dug a tunnel beneath the tax office and emerged with every missing receipt. The accountants have declared it a natural disaster.
lore.legendary: Its ancient sett has seven underground kingdoms, a throne of roots and a strictly enforced ban on lawnmowers. Even the moles pay rent.

names.legendary: Bisonthar, Mountain That Walks

lore.common: Scratches its back against a fence until the fence moves to the next field.
lore.uncommon: Rolls in enough dust to create a small weather system. Local forecasts describe it as hairy.
lore.rare: Stands in the middle of the road so perfectly still that drivers report a newly discovered hill.
lore.epic: Led a stampede so immense the prairie trembled beneath it. Every nearby earthquake sensor recorded the event as VERY LARGE COW.
lore.legendary: Bisonthar was ancient when the first grass grew on the plains. Each year its footsteps wake the earth from winter, and the hills remember how to move.

names.legendary: Professor Chimpanzo, Ape of All Trades

lore.common: Copies your serious expression perfectly, then improves it with a raspberry.
lore.uncommon: Uses a stick to steal the last banana without leaving its hammock. Calls it innovation.
lore.rare: Can pick every lock in the zoo, but always leaves the cages closed. The snacks are outside.
lore.epic: Founded a stock exchange where bananas rose, grapes crashed and the zookeeper lost his trousers in a hostile takeover.
lore.legendary: Professor Chimpanzo invented the first tools, then the first tool subscription service. The other apes are still paying monthly for access to a rock.

names.legendary: Chinchillia, Duchess of Velvet

lore.common: Bathes in dust, then shakes it onto the only freshly cleaned shelf. Has standards.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a walking cloud with a tail. The vacuum cleaner is strangely frightened of it.
lore.rare: Escapes any grasp by leaving behind a perfectly shaped cloud of fluff. The cat has built an entire collection.
lore.epic: Unleashed a silver fur storm at the royal ball. Every noble emerged wearing a new wig, and nobody admitted enjoying it.
lore.legendary: Chinchillia's fur is woven from the hush between snowflakes. The winter spirits begged for a blanket; she charged them three raisins and the best pillow in heaven.

names.legendary: Warrigal, the Unfenced King

lore.common: Invites itself to campfire dinners. Never brings a sausage of its own.
lore.uncommon: Can stare through a tent wall and identify exactly where the biscuits are hidden.
lore.rare: Steals a campsite's entire breakfast without waking anybody, except the toaster.
lore.epic: Its pack howled a dust storm into the shape of a giant dog, then used the moving shadow to raid three outback barbecue competitions.
lore.legendary: No fence was ever built that could hold Warrigal. The desert winds carry its howl from camp to camp, along with very detailed complaints about the food.

names.legendary: Don Quixotail, Knight of the Standoff

lore.common: Stops in the middle of a path and informs the cart it may continue without him.
lore.uncommon: Brays every time someone tries to deliver an important speech. Nobody has finished one yet.
lore.rare: Carried a mountain of supplies up a cliff and still refused to move for a single carrot.
lore.epic: A conquering army tried to make it surrender a bridge. The donkey sat down, and the war ended from sheer embarrassment.
lore.legendary: Don Quixotail stood before the greatest warhorse in history and refused to budge. The horse bowed first. The statue commemorating the duel depicts one donkey eating thistles.

names.legendary: Dugorath, Dreamer of the Blue Pastures

lore.common: Eats so slowly that seaweed grows back before lunch is over.
lore.uncommon: Surfaces beside boats to ask whether the buffet is still open.
lore.rare: Can convince sailors it is a mermaid from a distance. Up close, it asks for more seagrass.
lore.epic: Ate an entire underwater meadow by accident and then replanted it, one blade at a time. The seahorses gave it an extremely stern award.
lore.legendary: Dugorath once held a royal audience beneath the waves, but spent the ceremony eating seagrass. The sea king granted it a kingdom anyway, on condition that it never lead a speech.

names.legendary: Fernando, Prince of the Unfindable

lore.common: Steals a sock, hides the other one and congratulates itself on a perfect crime.
lore.uncommon: Performs the weasel war dance until it collides with a chair. Declares victory anyway.
lore.rare: Can vanish through the gap under a door and emerge wearing the owner's missing watch.
lore.epic: Raided every wardrobe in town in a single night. By morning the entire population had one sock, and the ferrets had opened a knitwear empire.
lore.legendary: Fernando once slipped inside the royal treasury through a keyhole. He stole nothing but the king's slippers, and the monarch spent the next decade addressing court in his socks.

names.legendary: Gerbilon, Architect of the Underworld

lore.common: Chews its cardboard tube to pieces and then looks for a new one to complain about.
lore.uncommon: Drums its back feet to announce danger, especially the terrifying sight of a carrot.
lore.rare: Builds a tunnel with six entrances and emerges from none of them until bedtime.
lore.epic: Chewed the cardboard stock of the entire post office into confetti. The postmaster delivered the parcels wearing a party hat.
lore.legendary: Beneath the oldest pet shop lies Gerbilon's kingdom of tunnels. The tunnels lead to every cage, but the secret exit comes out inside the biscuit jar.

names.legendary: Gibboria, Queen of the Thousand Branches

lore.common: Swings across the room on the curtains and lands on the biscuit tin.
lore.uncommon: Uses its long arms to steal bananas without leaving the sofa.
lore.rare: Sings at dawn in such a beautiful duet that the birds ask for singing lessons.
lore.epic: Swung through the whole city using washing lines and escaped with every sock. The laundries formed a rescue squad.
lore.legendary: Gibboria swings from one ancient tree to another across a forest too vast to cross on foot. The branches bend to greet her, and the sunrise waits for her final song.

names.legendary: Sir Hedgewick, Defender of the Snails

lore.common: Rolls into a prickly ball whenever the garden gnome looks at it funny.
lore.uncommon: Snuffles through the lawn at midnight like a miniature vacuum cleaner with opinions.
lore.rare: Carries a different leaf on each spine and has accidentally become the autumn parade's smallest float.
lore.epic: Rolled down the hill wearing an entire pile of fallen leaves. The park rangers declared it a seasonal weather phenomenon.
lore.legendary: Sir Hedgewick once curled around a sleeping fairy to keep the winter frost away. The fairy blessed every hedgehog with a secret map of warm garden corners.

names.legendary: Grizelda, Queen of the Midnight Cackle

lore.common: Laughs at its own jokes and never tells anyone the punchline.
lore.uncommon: Crunches through leftovers while the lions are still arguing over the menu.
lore.rare: Summons its whole clan with one cackle. Nearby safari guides call it the world's least subtle dinner bell.
lore.epic: Cackled so loudly through the king's safari banquet that every chair shook and the guests fled with their desserts.
lore.legendary: Grizelda won her crown not by strength but by laughing in the face of every challenger. The savannah still falls silent when her legendary giggle begins.

names.legendary: Jackalina, Keeper of the Desert Pact

lore.common: Practises its howling in the moonlight but keeps forgetting the tune.
lore.uncommon: Makes off with a feast while the lions are still arguing about who caught it.
lore.rare: Convinces a hyena, a leopard and a vulture that the others have already paid for its dinner.
lore.epic: Gathered every jackal of the desert beneath a full moon and held a concert so loud the dunes started to tremble. The camels asked for quiet hours.
lore.legendary: Jackalina bargained with the desert wind for a secret path between the oases. She gives its directions only to those who share their last scrap of food.

names.legendary: Boomerangaroo, the Horizon Leaper

lore.common: Keeps keys, biscuits and an alarmed little lizard in its pouch.
lore.uncommon: Balances on its tail to box with a fence post, then declares victory.
lore.rare: Clears an entire car in one leap and waits politely for applause from the passengers.
lore.epic: Bounced across a whole outback town at dawn, leaving potholes shaped like giant footprints. The road crew asked it to use the pavement.
lore.legendary: Boomerangaroo crossed the red desert in one impossible bound to bring rain clouds to thirsty wallabies. Its landing made the great round waterhole that still bears its name.

names.legendary: Duchess Whiskerdoom, the Sleepless

lore.common: Ambushes the toes under the blanket at three in the morning and demands a rematch at four.
lore.uncommon: Unravels three balls of wool, tangles itself into a scarf, then sleeps through the rescue.
lore.rare: Climbs to the top of the curtains and charges a rescue fee of two biscuits.
lore.epic: Conquered an entire furniture showroom by sharpening its claws on every sofa. The owner now sells them as distressed antiques.
lore.legendary: Duchess Whiskerdoom rules a kingdom beneath the sofa where lost toy mice are her knights. Each night she marches upon the bedroom, and no bare ankle is safe.

names.legendary: Lemuriel, Keeper of the Island Dawn

lore.common: Stares at every visitor as if deciding whether they would taste good with a grape.
lore.uncommon: Wears its striped tail like a royal scarf and looks offended when it gets caught in a branch.
lore.rare: Raises its arms toward the morning sun until the whole troop looks like a very small choir.
lore.epic: Led a procession of leaping lemurs across the jungle canopy, turning every tree into a bouncing drum. The island sounded like a parade.
lore.legendary: Lemuriel welcomed the first sunrise over its ancient island with a chorus from a hundred treetops. The sun has never missed the appointment, though the lemurs still send reminders.

names.legendary: Manatina, the Duchess of Slow Tides

lore.common: Floats so peacefully that tourists mistake it for a very comfortable rock.
lore.uncommon: Devours entire floating gardens of lettuce and politely burps at the fish.
lore.rare: Slows the wake of every passing boat with a gentle swish of its paddle-shaped tail.
lore.epic: Arrived at the harbour picnic and held the entire festival hostage by taking a three-hour nap in the ferry lane. Everyone watched happily.
lore.legendary: Manatina has guided the warm currents through winter for ages. When storms rage above, young sea creatures gather beneath her broad shadow and sleep without fear.

names.legendary: Meera, Sentinel of the Seven Dunes

lore.common: Stands on its hind legs whenever someone rustles a crisp packet.
lore.uncommon: Takes the dawn lookout shift and immediately asks whether naps are included.
lore.rare: Spots the shadow of a hawk before it reaches the ground, warning every tunnel in the colony.
lore.epic: Organised all the desert animals into a lookout rota, complete with whistles, lunch breaks and a very uncooperative camel.
lore.legendary: Meera kept watch through seven sandstorms when the entire colony slept. Her call guided the last lost kits home, and the dunes still echo her warning at sundown.

names.legendary: Molethar, Architect of the Secret Below

lore.common: Pops up from the lawn, looks at the gardener's hard work and quietly adds another hill.
lore.uncommon: Wears velvet fur that feels the same whichever way you stroke it. Will not stop asking you to check.
lore.rare: Dug a tunnel beneath every garden fence and now charges worms a toll.
lore.epic: Turned the village bowling green into a bouncing carpet of tunnels. The bowls finished the match before the players landed.
lore.legendary: Molethar built a second kingdom beneath the roots of the oldest forest. Its tunnels are so intricate that earthquakes must ask permission to pass through.

names.legendary: Mungo the Unbitten, Bane of Cobras

lore.common: Cracks eggs by hurling them between its back legs. The kitchen has issued a lifetime ban.
lore.uncommon: Slips through the grass with the speed of a rumour. The chickens don't believe in it.
lore.rare: Dances around a cobra's strike and bows before stealing its lunch.
lore.epic: Challenged the snake court to a duel on its own palace steps. By sunset the cobras were paying admission to watch the footwork.
lore.legendary: Mungo defeated the seven crowned serpents of the old jungle without taking a single bite. Their fangs hang above his burrow entrance, where he uses them to hang washing.

names.legendary: Bogfather Mossrack, Lord of the Lakes

lore.common: Treats hanging flower baskets as roadside snacks. The village florist keeps sending invoices.
lore.uncommon: Stands chest-deep in lakes chewing water plants, then sneezes green confetti at anglers.
lore.rare: Blocks a highway by taking an exceptionally long lunch. Drivers have started a queue for autographs.
lore.epic: Walked through the winter parade with the festive lights tangled in its antlers. Every reindeer in town immediately resigned.
lore.legendary: Bogfather Mossrack carried the last migrating flock of wild geese across the frozen northern lake in his antlers. They still return every spring to sit upon his great crown.

names.legendary: Montgomery Mousesworth, the Unseen

lore.common: Nibbles one corner off every biscuit in the tin so nobody can claim a complete one.
lore.uncommon: Runs along the skirting board like an important little messenger with terrible news about cheese.
lore.rare: Empties every mousetrap without springing it and leaves a polite note thanking the chef.
lore.epic: Led an army into the bakery and tunneled through the flour sacks. The baker woke to a thousand tiny powdered footprints marching toward the buns.
lore.legendary: Montgomery lived in the royal pantry for thirty winters, unseen and well fed. The king only learned of him when the cheese shortage was recorded as a national emergency.

names.legendary: Dame Morticia, Patron of Perfect Naps

lore.common: Pretends to faint whenever the rubbish needs taking out. Its acting is dreadful but very committed.
lore.uncommon: Hangs by its tail long enough to steal a picnic biscuit, then drops directly into the jam.
lore.rare: Flashes fifty tiny teeth at an approaching fox. The fox decides it has another appointment.
lore.epic: Staged its own funeral so convincingly that the forest held a memorial feast. It rose from the flowers at dessert and asked for seconds.
lore.legendary: Dame Morticia fooled the Night Collector himself by playing dead for a hundred years. When he finally left, she opened one eye and stole his lunchbox.

names.legendary: Ottoline, Keeper of the First Stone

lore.common: Uses its belly as a dinner table and refuses to share the best shellfish.
lore.uncommon: Holds hands while napping so nobody drifts off without saying goodbye.
lore.rare: Juggles river stones with such precision that even the kingfishers stop fishing to watch.
lore.epic: Built a mudslide from the mountain spring to the harbour. Every otter in the valley arrived, followed by three very confused fishermen.
lore.legendary: Ottoline's favourite stone could crack any shell but never a promise. When the river froze, she used it to break open a path for every hungry creature on the shore.

names.legendary: Platypatra, First of the Misfit Wonders

lore.common: Looks like three animals were assembled from spare parts and nobody checked the instructions.
lore.uncommon: Lays an egg, then politely refuses to answer questions from the other mammals.
lore.rare: Senses the flicker of living prey beneath muddy water without using its eyes. The prawns have begun hiding their thoughts.
lore.epic: Invited every animal in the forest to prove it was not a real mammal. After a week of arguments, it handed the judges an egg and swam away.
lore.legendary: Platypatra was born when the river asked nature for one creature that could never be neatly categorised. It carries the river's strange wisdom in its bill and a hidden warning in its heel.

names.legendary: Nanu of the First Polar Dawn

lore.common: Rolls in fresh snow until it resembles a suspiciously cheerful snowball.
lore.uncommon: Slides on its belly straight into its mother's enormous paws.
lore.rare: Finds safe paths through cracked sea ice by listening to the water beneath.
lore.epic: Sneezed during a blizzard and sent a mountain of loose snow tumbling harmlessly into the sea. The seals rated the wave a perfect ten.
lore.legendary: Nanu guided a stranded expedition through the polar night, following stars reflected beneath the ice. The explorers built a little snow monument in its honour, and found it wearing the hat.

names.legendary: Quillandra, Keeper of the Living Forest

lore.common: Bumps into a cushion and leaves it looking like a very expensive pincushion.
lore.uncommon: Chews tree bark loudly enough to attract annoyed woodpeckers from the next valley.
lore.rare: Raises its quills into a rattling warning that makes even hungry predators rethink dinner.
lore.epic: Defended a woodland nursery by surrounding it with a living wall of bristling quills. The foxes agreed to admire the baby rabbits from elsewhere.
lore.legendary: Quillandra guarded the forest's youngest trees through a winter of hungry giants. Every spine she shed became a new sapling when the thaw finally came.

names.legendary: Possumia, Queen of the Midnight Canopy

lore.common: Thumps across the roof in the middle of the night and pretends to be a burglar.
lore.uncommon: Hisses at the neighbour's cat and eats its biscuits while the cat looks offended.
lore.rare: Steals ripe fruit without touching a single unripe one. The orchard owner wants to hire it.
lore.epic: Led a moonlit raid across every fruit tree in the suburb, leaving neatly sorted pips on each doorstep. The residents suspect an extremely organised gang.
lore.legendary: Possumia built a secret highway across the highest branches of the ancient forest. Generations of night creatures have crossed it safely without ever touching the dangerous ground.

names.legendary: Biscuitus, Heart of the Wild Pack

lore.common: Chews one slipper, then puts the other one in its bed as a peace offering.
lore.uncommon: Trips over its enormous paws while racing to greet the postman.
lore.rare: Gives the whole household puppy eyes until every person volunteers their dinner.
lore.epic: Invited a hundred puppies to a royal garden party. The lawn became a maze of tunnels and the king lost both shoes.
lore.legendary: Biscuitus was the smallest pup in a wolf pack, yet its first bark stopped a winter avalanche. The wolves still leave the warmest sleeping spot for it.

names.legendary: Raccalino, Prince of the Midnight Heist

lore.common: Opens the bin, inspects its contents, and leaves a terrible review.
lore.uncommon: Washes its stolen doughnut in a birdbath, losing all the icing but none of its dignity.
lore.rare: Can unfasten almost any lid, latch or gate with its little burglar hands.
lore.epic: Organised a midnight heist of every rubbish bin in the city. The police found a mountain of neatly sorted recycling and one smug raccoon.
lore.legendary: Raccalino stole the keys to the royal pantry and divided the feast among the forest's hungry creatures. His black mask has been a symbol of woodland mischief ever since.

names.legendary: Rattavell, Architect of the Undercity

lore.common: Steals the cereal and leaves a trail of crumbs straight to its nest.
lore.uncommon: Knows every drain beneath the city and charges tourists one cracker per shortcut.
lore.rare: Solves every maze in seconds and leaves the scientists a crossword puzzle in return.
lore.epic: Chewed tunnels beneath all the shops on the high street. The town now has the world's least hygienic underground shopping centre.
lore.legendary: Rattavell built an entire secret city beneath the palace using discarded keys, stolen books and one magnificent cheese vault. No cat has ever found its gate.

names.legendary: Rangiferra, Shepherd of the Polar Dawn

lore.common: Makes a clicking noise with each step, so its attempt to sneak up on a carrot never works.
lore.uncommon: Digs through snowy ground and finds lichen that every other reindeer has missed.
lore.rare: Runs across the frozen tundra with a herd following perfectly in its tracks.
lore.epic: Led ten thousand reindeer over a mountain pass during a blizzard. The snowplough drivers asked for its route map.
lore.legendary: Rangiferra once caught the northern lights in her antlers and carried them across the polar night. The other reindeer demanded matching decorations.

names.legendary: Rhinovar, Defender of the Last Waterhole

lore.common: Charges a bush, loses the argument, then pretends it only wanted a scratch.
lore.uncommon: Rolls in mud until it wears a magnificent crusty suit of armour.
lore.rare: Protects the waterhole from prowling predators with a single lowered horn.
lore.epic: Stampeded across the savannah and carved a new riverbed with its colossal hooves. The hippos asked when the water would arrive.
lore.legendary: Rhinovar stopped a stampede by planting his horn in the ground and refusing to move. The path around him became the first roundabout on the savannah.

names.legendary: Sir Flipperton, Master of the Pier

lore.common: Barks at every fishing boat and expects an answer in the same language.
lore.uncommon: Balances a shiny pebble on its nose until somebody remembers to applaud.
lore.rare: Can hear a fish leap on the far side of the harbour and arrives before the splash settles.
lore.epic: Hijacked a brass-band concert on the pier and performed the entire finale in honks. The conductor offered it a permanent position.
lore.legendary: Sir Flipperton once balanced the moon's reflection on his nose through an entire night of waves. At dawn he flipped it back into the sky before anyone noticed it was missing.

names.legendary: Selkie Grey, Singer Beneath the Waves

lore.common: Flops onto a rock and refuses to move even when the tide reaches its whiskers.
lore.uncommon: Claps with its flippers every time a fish escapes from the fishing net. The fisherman is not amused.
lore.rare: Bobs up beside a swimmer and remembers their face from last summer.
lore.epic: Gathered every seal on the rocky coast for a midnight concert. The lighthouse keeper wore three pairs of earmuffs and requested an encore.
lore.legendary: Selkie Grey sheds her seal skin on one night each year to walk the moonlit shore. The tide sings her old name until she returns to the sea at dawn.

names.legendary: Stinkoria, Duchess of the Forbidden Air

lore.common: Raises its tail at a picnic and clears the table without eating a single sandwich.
lore.uncommon: Performs a warning handstand so elaborate that everyone applauds before running away.
lore.rare: Can drive every unwelcome guest from a campsite with a single careful flick of its tail.
lore.epic: Released such an astonishing pong at the annual flower show that the roses requested gas masks. The judges awarded first place to the empty tent.
lore.legendary: Stinkoria once saved the woodland creatures from a greedy giant with one elegant warning spray. His boots still air on the mountain, and no giant has entered the forest since.

names.legendary: Slotharion, the Hour That Never Ended

lore.common: Takes a full minute to wave goodbye to a friend who already went home.
lore.uncommon: Grows a little moss garden in its fur and charges the beetles rent.
lore.rare: Slows the rain around its branch so it can finish a nap without getting wet.
lore.epic: Delayed the jungle's sunrise for an entire hour by refusing to climb down from the highest tree. Even the parrots overslept.
lore.legendary: Slotharion slept on the first branch that ever grew and woke centuries later with a forest around him. His three slow claws still hold a moment of peace untouched by the rushing world.

names.legendary: Wallarina, the Little Giant of the Bush

lore.common: Steals one crisp from the campsite, then hops away looking very important.
lore.uncommon: Reminds kangaroos that being smaller means fitting through the picnic gate.
lore.rare: Leaps across a rocky ridge so lightly its shadow gets left behind.
lore.epic: Bounced through an entire garden wedding and knocked every hat into the swimming pool. The bride asked it to join the dance anyway.
lore.legendary: Outran the great drought to find a spring hidden beyond the red cliffs. Returned with its pouch full of seeds and grew a new green valley.

names.legendary: Odoboros, the Keeper of Arctic Shores

lore.common: Wears a magnificent moustache full of yesterday's shellfish.
lore.uncommon: Slurps clams with such gusto that nearby seals applaud sarcastically.
lore.rare: Hauls itself over pack ice with tusks sharp enough to carve a staircase.
lore.epic: Flopped onto an ice floe so hard it split into a dozen pieces. It spent the afternoon ferrying stranded penguins home.
lore.legendary: Kept the oldest seal colony safe through a season without solid ice, using its great tusks to pull drifting floes together into a floating sanctuary.

names.legendary: Mustelix, the Thief of the Golden Egg

lore.common: Sneaks out of the hen house carrying an egg twice the size of its head.
lore.uncommon: Slips through a gap so small the mouse asks it for architectural advice.
lore.rare: Steals a shiny ring from a royal dinner and returns it in exchange for cake.
lore.epic: Danced so wildly through the village fair that the Morris dancers put down their bells and asked it to teach the next set.
lore.legendary: Stole a golden egg from a dragon's treasury without waking a single scale. Left the dragon a perfectly ordinary egg with a handwritten thank-you note.

names.legendary: Gnuvalis, Drumbeat of the Plains

lore.common: Bucks for no obvious reason and then continues chewing grass.
lore.uncommon: Sports a beard, mane and horns that look borrowed from three separate animals.
lore.rare: Charges through a river so powerfully that even crocodiles make way.
lore.epic: Led a thundering migration across the savannah, raising a cloud of dust visible from the moon. Its own calves thought the sky was following them.
lore.legendary: Began the first great migration when the grasslands were fading. Every year its descendants follow the rhythm of its ancient hooves toward the returning rains.

names.legendary: Yaksha, the Mountain's Warm Heart

lore.common: Grunts at hikers who stop to take photographs of its magnificent fringe.
lore.uncommon: Carries so much wool on its back that the snow thinks it is a moving hill.
lore.rare: Finds safe mountain tracks through whiteout blizzards by tasting the wind on its enormous nose.
lore.epic: Thunderhoof Yakkar crossed a frozen pass with an entire wedding procession on his back. The bride arrived first; the cake is still climbing.
lore.legendary: Yaksha carried embers from the last valley fire across a mountain of snow. Where his hooves touched the ice, warm springs rose; the village still bathes in them each winter.

names.legendary: Zebrion, Painter of the First Stripes

lore.common: Claims the town's pedestrian crossings are portraits of its ancestors.
lore.uncommon: Stands beside a barcode scanner until someone tries to pay for it.
lore.rare: Can scatter its stripes across the grass as decoys, leaving hungry lions chasing black-and-white shadows.
lore.epic: General Monochromancer led ten thousand zebras in a spinning formation that turned the savannah into a hypnotic chessboard. The lions all moved diagonally.
lore.legendary: When the plains were colourless, Zebrion borrowed the first shadows at sunrise and painted them onto his herd. They still carry those moving stripes so every foal can find its family at dusk.
